author: Binay Verma
status: Exploratory. Registered and committed before any sunday_day, replace_pooled or replace_typed NYC forecast exists. The NYC calendar, typed and pooled arms were already inspected. Not a confirmation.
question: Do the Ziel (2018) hSun and replacing encodings change the local-model ordering on the separate NYC holiday cases?
source_method: Ziel (2018) J. Mod. Power Syst. Clean Energy 6(2), 191-207: Section 4.3 hSun and Section 4.5 replacing (Rph, RpH, Eq. 11), adapted to daily observance anchors.
new_arm_definition: sunday_day: calendar with weekday one-hot replaced by dow_6 on any family anchor day, plus five zeros. replace_pooled: pooled_day5 with dow_0..dow_6 = 0 on flagged days. replace_typed: day5 with dow_0..dow_6 = 0 on any family anchor day. 18 channels each; training and query dates alike.

reproduction_check: Reference-arm predictions must match results/mta_holiday_v1 local predictions within atol 1e-7, rtol 1e-9, and the stored balanced MASE within 1e-12. Otherwise the new arms are not interpreted.
metrics: Row MASE = |prediction - actual| / fixed 2024-01-02..2025-12-31 weekly scale. Balanced MASE = mean over families of the mean over (mode, year) cells (the parent aggregate). Model steps 8/14/21 = decision leads 1/7/14.
reporting: Every model, contrast and lead: balanced value, value per mode, leave-one-family-out values, and family/mode cell signs. No p-values or bootstrap. Two observances and two related modes: a bounded robustness check only.
interpretation: Consistent only if the sign holds in both modes and in both leave-one-family-out subsets; values below 0.005 MASE in absolute size are negligible; otherwise unstable.
